qualification: Run the one-reflection policy once on all 16 validation tasks, using identical common training experience and per-job limits. Compare its score with the already retained base/GEPA validation results.
runtime_choice: Highest validation acceptance; exact ties prefer ordinary retrieval, then single reflection, then GEPA. Freeze the chosen policy before the first test proposal.
gepa_primary_gate: The original two-control improvement rule remains unchanged; no update means no learned-policy advantage.
runtime_learning_comparison: Evaluate the validation-chosen policy versus the ordinary strong retrieval/self-check agent. Report exact paired one-sided p and a conservative three-comparison correction; claim supported improvement only with positive difference and adjusted p<=.05. All three method comparisons remain visible.
identical_policy_execution: GEPA retained the identical base policy. Reuse and explicitly label that exact execution instead of purchasing duplicate inference; this condition must tie the base, not produce an apparent learning gain.
